title: OpenTwinInterpretationDocumentV02
description: Sole interface between the open-twin interpretation layer and the open-twin-openXR visualisation layer. Schema is the source of truth; TypeScript types are generated from this file.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Consumers must reject unknown versions.

intended_use.description: MDR Annex VIII Rule 11 line (D-m). Visualising a person's own data can sit outside MDR; generating recommendations cannot. This document never carries recommendations.

not_for_diagnostic_use.description: Always true. A false value is non-conformant (D-m).

subject_ref.description: Opaque subject reference (e.g. Patient fullUrl or research pseudonym). Not a display name.

as_of.description: Instant the interpretation document was produced (UTC).

states.description: Per-SystemId interpretive states for systems the XR layer can colour. Markers with no SystemId home must appear only under unrenderable[] (D-g).

unrenderable.description: States that must not be painted onto anatomy. Never drop; never reroute into a neighbouring SystemId (D-g).

SystemId.description: Closed enum owned by open-twin-openXR (D8 / D-f). This repository CONSUMES it. No tenth value.

Severity.description: Ordinal severity (D-i). Not a float — a float implies a calibration the rules do not have.

ContributorStatus.description: Status of a marker the rule read, including absences (D-k).

InterpretiveAnatomySource.description: Provenance of the anatomy assignment (D-h). The LOINC System axis is a specimen, not a site of pathology — value "loinc_system_axis" is REJECTED by CI.

biomarker_id.description: Stable marker id from the Anchor layer (e.g. BM-072).

loinc_code.description: Optional LOINC code the rule bound for this contributor.

observed_at.description: Observation instant when status is present or stale; null when missing.

reference_interval_id.description: Interval the observation was measured against, or null when the interpreter abstains (D-a).

Geometry.description: Geometry keys for XR join (D-l). Joins run FMA → UBERON, never the reverse. Prefer FMA when both bridges resolve. body_structure_snomed is INTERNAL ONLY and must not appear in published documents.

fma_id.description: Primary geometry key (Foundational Model of Anatomy CURIE).

uberon_id.description: Secondary semantic / query key. Joined from FMA, never the reverse.

confidence.description: RULE-SUPPORT in [0,1], defined as completeness × recency × rule_strength. This is NOT a probability of disease and must not be rendered as risk. See docs/contracts/confidence.md (D-j).

sufficient_data.description: When false the state is still EMITTED with its reason. A region with no data must never be renderable as healthy (D-k).

insufficient_reason.description: Required by conformance when sufficient_data is false.

contributing.description: Every marker the rule read, INCLUDING missing ones (D-k).

id.description: Stable id for this unrenderable group (e.g. cbc_block).

label.description: Human-readable label for research UI (not painted on anatomy).

confidence.description: RULE-SUPPORT in [0,1] — completeness × recency × rule_strength; NOT probability of disease (D-j).
